hints.telegramTopic: Forum groups only. Leave blank for a normal chat or channel.
hints.smtpPreset: Fills the host, port and security for common providers. Amazon SES and Mailgun EU need the region edited into the host.
hints.smtpVerifyCertificate: Checks the mail server's TLS certificate against a trusted authority. Turn it off only for a server with a self-signed certificate, such as a local bridge: anyone on the path between Tracearr and the mail server can then intercept the connection.
hints.smtpUsernameOptional: Leave blank when the server needs no login
hints.smtpTo: Alerts go out as one email with every address here in To. Leave it blank if this server only sends newsletters.
hints.smtpRate: Per Tracearr instance; stay under your provider's limit
hints.smtpMessageStream: Postmark only: the stream ID to send through, for example broadcast. Leave blank elsewhere.
hints.smtpGmailUsername: Your full Gmail address. Gmail sends from this address whatever the sender address says, and personal accounts stop near 500 recipients a day.
hints.smtpGmailPassword: An app password from Google Account > Security > 2-Step Verification > App passwords. Your account password is rejected.
hints.smtpResendPassword: Your Resend API key. The sender domain must be verified in Resend first.
hints.smtpMailgunPassword: The SMTP password from that domain's settings. A sandbox domain only reaches its authorized recipients.
hints.smtpBrevoPassword: An SMTP key from SMTP & API > SMTP, not the API key.
hints.smtpSesUsername: The SMTP user name from the SES console, not an IAM access key. Put your region in the host.
hints.smtpSesPassword: The SMTP password from the SES console. Sandbox accounts send 200 messages a day to verified addresses only.
hints.smtpPostmarkPassword: The same Server API token, or a stream token's secret.
